_about: Strategies the daily scan may run. Every parameter the backtest used is here, so the scan trades exactly what was validated and nothing else. Change a value only by validating the new version first; record why in research/FINDINGS.md.

momentum_quality_top20.status: validated on dev and validation; paper trading only
momentum_quality_top20.description: Each month, the 20 eligible stocks with the highest 12-month return (skipping the last month) per unit of one-year volatility, equal weight.
momentum_quality_top20.rebalance: last NSE trading day of each month, orders at the next open

evidence.dev 2013-2020: CAGR 26.1% against 8.8% for the equal-weight universe; Sharpe 0.81 against 0.20; worst drawdown -38.5% against -58.2%; IC 0.045 (t 2.50)
evidence.validation 2021-2023: CAGR 47.4% against 34.6%; Sharpe 1.49 against 1.41; worst drawdown -33.4% against -23.2%; 2022 -7% against +2%; IC 0.056 (t 2.74), deciles 0.99 orderly
evidence.known weaknesses: Deeper drawdowns than the market in rotations (2016, 2022); the edge is in return more than in risk. Market-timing filters failed validation and are not used.
